definitions.explanation: A heartfelt, honest attitude; loyalty and trustworthiness in one's words and actions. A core virtue in traditional Japanese ethics, often associated with bushidō and Confucian values.
What is actually the case; truth as opposed to falsehood. Somewhat literary or formal; everyday speech uses {本当|ほんとう} instead.

examples.japanese: {誠|まこと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧。
examples.english: To act with sincerity / give one's all faithfully.
He is a person of integrity.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{誠|まこと}⟦をもって→をもって：06946_womotte⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We respond to customers with utmost sincerity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧{誠|まこと}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Everything I just told you is the truth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{誠|まこと}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{偽|いつわ}り→偽り：09999_itsuwari⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{確|たし}かめていない→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧。
examples.english: I haven't yet verified whether the rumor is true or false.

notes:
An older native Japanese word that has taken on a somewhat formal or literary tone in modern usage. Also a very common given name (especially masculine).

ADVERBIAL USE — {誠|まこと}に:
The most frequent modern usage is as the adverb {誠|まこと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (truly, sincerely, indeed), heard in polite business expressions:
- {誠|まこと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧: thank you very much (sincerely)
- {誠|まこと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません→申し訳ありません：21409_moushiwakearimasen⟧: I am truly sorry
- {誠|まこと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: I am truly sorry to trouble you

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誠|まこと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧: to act with utmost sincerity
- {誠|まこと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}める→込める：01945_komeru⟧: to put one's heart into
- {誠|まこと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person of integrity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧: truth — modern, neutral word for truth; more common than {誠|まこと} for sense 2
- ⟦{誠実|せいじつ}→誠実：14211_seijitsu⟧: sincere; faithful — the な-adjective form covering the same virtue
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧: true; really — everyday equivalent of sense 2
